テキスト cha 426: Born Shiyo 782, April 30. Height 166cm (as of Shiyo 800). A 3rd-year at Motoki High School. She lives in the room next to Natsumi Kogori's, and both her speech and her manner are boyish. She always has Natsumi Kogori on her mind, and if anything makes her suffer she tries somehow to take it away.
Out of a taste for the frightening she likes to stick her nose into talk of horror and crime. In fact she is timid, and when the talk actually starts she is said to be more frightened than anyone.
As a small child she moved away from Motoki-cho for a time. 3 years ago, in Shiyo 797, her father was transferred overseas, and she came back to Motoki-cho with her mother Mifuyu Niimura.

She claims to have made paper dolls and laid a curse on the 3 of the Kogori family. She also says she is the culprit of the Megasawa City murders and that she has cursed 6 people to death in the past, but Erina Goto is skeptical of it.
She believes it is common sense to wear a Noh mask and a large outer robe at memorial rites.

She witnesses the butchery at the Kogori house and loses Natsumi Kogori, her support, and her mother. Saying that it no longer matters who the culprit is or whether it is a curse, she drives a knife into her own throat.
In Shiyo 798 (then 16 and a 1st-year in high school), she was on her way to a hospital for some reason. But she would not reveal the reason even to Natsumi Kogori.
Pizza is her favorite food, and if there is an Italian event she gets on her bicycle and rushes there.

She insists the shinigami will attack before long and pronounces death on Natsumi Kogori. Natsumi Kogori is deeply disappointed in her, however, and she resolves instead to protect Natsumi Kogori from the shinigami.
She is struck by a car and falls into a coma, but as of Shiyo 802 there is a description that reads as though she has regained consciousness.

Though weak in English and the science subjects, she is quite outstanding in Japanese and social studies, to the point that classmates ask her how she studies. In geography especially, she seems to have been confident she could get a perfect score even on a hard test.
She apparently dislikes spicy food and coffee. She does at least show an attitude of trying to overcome them, but it seems to be quite hard for her after all.

シナリオ名: Haruka and the Witch and the Shinigami
テキスト cha 426: After the Motoki-cho incident she moves to the Arata settlement, where her father's family home is, and has not been heard from since.

シナリオ名: The Day the Witch Was Born
テキスト cha 426: At her elementary school in Megasawa City, she stood up for a girl who was being bullied, and that made her the next target. After that she grew seriously interested in curses, and she was bullied by classmates who found that creepy or mocked her for it.

When the paper doll appears, she senses the danger closing in on the Kogori family. She seems torn between taking Natsumi Kogori to investigate the park and inviting Erina Goto home to consult her. In fact, this is the major branch point between the Jusatsu Arc [Killing by Curse] and the Meicho Arc [Clear Sign], and it greatly affects what follows.

At first she was reluctant about the Russian-roulette takoyaki battle, but she seems to have enjoyed it quite a bit, finding a way to win and getting caught up in the mood. She seems to be the type easily swept along by those around her.

She flies into a rage at Erina Goto's deduction that Mifuyu Niimura's real target is Haruka herself, but quickly corrects her attitude. Inside, though, she cannot hide her anguish over why she has to be killed.

シナリオ名: I'm the Type Who Looks Slimmer in Clothes
テキスト cha 426: She has apparently hit on a genius idea to prevent any further tragedy. It is a method only Haruka Niimura can carry out, it seems.
盗聴器を使った罠と祖母のモノマネで新村美冬を捕獲することに成功する。

After the case, she meets Mifuyu Niimura face to face. Furious at Mifuyu Niimura for scorning herself as a failure as a mother, she pleads how much she has been helped until now. She says that even if Mifuyu committed murder, if it was for her sake she could never cut ties with her, and declares that she will go on accepting her as her mother.
It seems she had been made to practice impressions of her grandmother since early childhood, and by coincidence that led to solving the case.

On the night of the day Natsumi Kogori moves into the Niimura house, she is told that Natsumi Kogori has found a drug called Droga. Immediately afterward a loud sound and a caller in the middle of the night turn her fate around once again.
Born the eldest daughter of the Kogori family, she was soon given up for adoption to the Niimura family. However, she is not to be told this fact until she comes of age.
After Eiichiro Niimura's death, she is taken away from Motoki-cho by the shocked Mifuyu Niimura.

Recognizing that Mifuyu Niimura plotted murder because of her own curse, she apologizes for it. She had cursed the bullies in the first place not so much to escape the bullying herself as out of fear that her mother, who worried about the bullying, would weaken in body and mind again.
She protests that the Niimura family's welcome goes too far, but they pay no mind, and each warmly welcomes Natsumi Kogori and Erina Goto in their own way.

A few days before Natsumi Kogori and the others came to Megasawa City in Shiyo 790, Haruka Niimura performed a charm from a book she found in the school library, trying to save Mifuyu Niimura. She believes its effect cured Mifuyu Niimura's illness and let them return to Motoki-cho, but she does not seem absorbed in charms now.
For Erina Goto, who is seriously working to find a lead to solve ten years of murders, she introduces Kotaro Niimura as powerful backup.

When told that Chigaya Niimura and Kana Niimura were made by Kotaro Niimura to train to kill, she is badly shaken; thinking Chigaya and her sister are murderers, she goes to warn Natsumi Kogori and the others.
She goes around calling Chigaya and Kana Niimura murderers, and for the first time is physically punished by Mifuyu Niimura. This brings her to her senses, and she realizes her thinking was wrong.
To rescue Mifuyu Niimura, caught up in Erika Niimura's fruitless impressions, she eggs Erina Goto on to burst in, but only makes things more chaotic.

Attacked by Kotaro Niimura underground, she stands up to him alone to protect Natsumi Kogori and the others. But Kotaro, on Droga, brushes her aside with ease. When he is about to finish her off, Natsumi, trying to shield her, takes the blow instead.
GREENEYE

Having learned the Kogori couple are her real parents, she comes to a hot-spring inn with them and the others, but at first she does not know how to act and is somewhat distant. Secretly asking Erina Goto for advice, she is told the obvious: "Just act natural like always, and if you can bring Mifuyu Niimura a good story from the trip, that's enough." Haruka, too, grasps that obvious thing anew and decides to act as always.

With Mifuyu Niimura, she visits the grave of a sister not related to her by blood. But her feelings are complicated: learning that this sister, too, had always received the love she thought was poured on her alone, she feels something like jealousy welling up. Still, she accepts it and thanks Mifuyu, who has always given her honest love: "Thank you for letting me visit her grave."

Realizing that the Arata settlement will soon be gone, she thinks about how to keep alive the settlement her grandmother Erika Niimura tried to protect. In the end, she resolves to give up her current life and move to the Arata settlement.

She tells Natsumi Kogori and Erina Goto she will leave Motoki-cho for the Arata settlement; they object, then tearfully cheer her on. Then a cherry petal appears in the room, and the main house's withered cherry blooms out of season. On that wind, her late grandmother Erika Niimura asks her to protect Arata from Motoki-cho. Perhaps embarrassed, she says, "Me, live in this dreary settlement? Obviously a joke," and stays.

The mountain seclusion has made her tougher by leaps and bounds, and she comes to rescue Momoko Goto and the others from a desperate spot. But she is shot dead by Momoko, who is struck by a murderous intent no one can explain.

シナリオ名: サード・ジェネレーション
テキスト cha 426: Learning that Mifuyu Niimura is the shinigami, she apologizes for driving her mother this far. Afterward, she takes in Kana Niimura, left alone in the Arata settlement, and will also live as sisters with Natsumi Kogori. She also reveres Momoko Goto as her Super Soda Bomber Master.

She shields Natsumi Kogori from Mifuyu Niimura's car and nearly dies, but survives. Yet she does not wake for 2 years, and after Natsumi's blood splashes on her she screams and thrashes in her coma. As the strain threatens her life, Natsumi has her put into an anesthetic sleep suppressing her reflexes for 48 hours. Natsumi's exchange transfusion frees her from the Green-Eye Curse-Killing, and she wakes the next morning.

シナリオ名: パラサイト・プリズン
テキスト cha 426: Taken to Arata by Mifuyu Niimura, she loses her mother and spends 2 years in the mountain seclusion to toughen herself. Back in the settlement, she apparently touches 'the Goddess's Blessing' and is reborn as a divine messenger. In Motoki City she has Natsumi Kogori and Akane Kogori reborn as divine messengers, and kills Erina Goto as she is "lonely and pitiful." As a divine messenger, Haruka has no human ethics left.

シナリオ名: メガミゴロシミナゴロシ
テキスト cha 426: After moving to the Arata settlement, she completes 2 years of the mountain seclusion to forge herself anew. Because of this, she has grown a size or two, both physically and mentally, and has gained physical ability and survival skills close to, if not quite equal to, those of Chigaya and Kana Niimura.

シナリオ名: メガミゴロシミナゴロシ
テキスト cha 426: Realizing she has no place to belong in the deserted Arata settlement, or in Motoki-cho, where no one she can open her heart to remains, she goes on living alone on Mount Itohime after Shiyo 802. What became of her after that is unknown.

On the day Chigaya Niimura arrives at the Arata settlement, she learns of the curse-killings over the phone. She passes on her talk with Chigaya to Natsumi Kogori, Erina Goto, and Mifuyu Niimura, but on the night of April 6, Chigaya vanishes. Because of this, she begins to doubt whether taking the two of them to the Arata settlement is right.
She learns of Motoki-cho's goshinboku and of the massacre of the public body's members who tried to research it, but undaunted, she decides that they will all head for the Arata settlement.

Erina Goto puts forward the idea that Chigaya Niimura may be in a place people can hardly enter, one where a mummy could be kept. To check that place, she heads for the underground storeroom with Mifuyu Niimura.

She goes to the underground storeroom with Mifuyu Niimura and finds a mummy beyond the part that had been sealed off. But since taking it out could needlessly stoke everyone's fears, it is left where it is for now.

She searches the graveyard clearing with Mifuyu Niimura but loses sight of her partway through, and instead runs into Chigaya Niimura. Attacked without a chance to fight back, she is told to go to the abandoned hut.

Told by Mifuyu Niimura to run from Arata, she reluctantly does as she is told and tries to get down the mountain. On the way, she encounters Sakura Niimura, who should be dead. Hearing about Shigatsu Youka's ecology and the present situation, she goes back to the settlement to tell the others.
